title: Damselflies
description: Damselflies is a simple resource pack that replaces the bees of Minecraft, with Damselflies!
body: Damsel Flies﻿ This resource pack requires Optifine! Damsel Flies is a simple resource pack that replaces the bees of Minecraft, with Damsel Flies! These majestic four-winged creatures can now be in your world too! I hope you enjoy :)
